name: kernora
displayName: Kernora — Your AI sessions have a memory now
description: Every AI coding session forgets everything. Nora remembers. Captures patterns, decisions, and bugs from Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro, and Cline — builds a context graph that makes every future session smarter. Track your AI Leverage Score. 100% local. Zero telemetry. BYOK.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Nora
walkthroughs.description: Install the Kernora backend, open a project, see grounding cite a factlet, run nora_help, and verify zero egress.

steps.title: Install the Kernora backend
steps.description:
One machine-level install under `~/.kernora/`. Required before grounding and MCP tools work.

[Open install docs](https://kernora.ai/#install)

steps.title: Open a project — grounding fires automatically
steps.description: Open a folder, run `kernora generate`, then ask your agent something your factbook covers. Grounding injects before the model writes.

steps.title: See a factlet cited
steps.description: A grounded turn names the factlet and its trust basis. Click the citation to open the decision trail.

steps.title: Run nora_help
steps.description: Ask `nora_help` in chat to list the MCP tools active on your tier (15 Lite / 60 Pro).

steps.title: Verify zero egress
steps.description:
0 bytes to Kernora servers by default. Run `kernora network-check` (or tcpdump) to verify.

[Open security page](https://kernora.ai/security.html)
